findings.issue: The Do line overstates what constant composition establishes: “constant means pure” should be “a constant ratio supports purity.”
findings.evidence: The published answer_move says a constant ratio “supports a pure substance,” not that it proves purity. A mixture can happen to maintain the same component proportions across the samples tested, so constant element mass ratios alone do not guarantee that a material is pure. The draft changes supporting evidence into a certainty.
